rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3BA blastocyst and notes loose ICM and good TE, but it overstates certainty on features not clearly discernible in the single image (e.g., exact ICM position, uniform cohesive TE, >90% cavity, no gaps/herniation).
Integrates age, AMH, ovarian response, male factor, prior miscarriage, BMI, and endometrium well with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are somewhat speculative.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible prognosis tied to embryo grade and patient age; minor issues include speculative adjustments and some unsupported quantitative claims.

Core recommendations like proceeding with single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but suggestions such as routine aspirin, thrombophilia/MTHFR testing, endometrial scratch, embryo glue emphasis, and relatively early PGT-A recommendation are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET and follow-up considerations, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
